integrity: Proof reconstructed from the stated normalizations, analytic Fourier estimates, and an explicitly identified previously published Schatten criterion. No invented independent certification or authorship.
scientific_limitations: The construction is on the standard one-variable Gaussian Fock Hilbert space for real \(0<\lambda<1\) and \(0<a<1\); it does not classify all radial powers or singular-value counting asymptotics. General Schatten integrability is prior work (Du 2011). The spatial-window divergence is not a singular-value law. Publication priority and independent mathematical audit remain unverified.
title: Fourier-edge compact Fock compositions with a sharp Schatten threshold
